domains.backend: Request handling, APIs, databases, queues, caching.
domains.data: Transformation, parsing, serialization, pipelines, file I/O.
domains.ml: Model loading, inference, embeddings, training utilities.
domains.infra: Deployment, config management, logging, monitoring, health checks.
domains.universal: Pure utilities with no domain dependency (string ops, retry, math, date handling). If a widget could reasonably belong to two domains, it belongs here.

general_notes: Single responsibility — one widget does one thing. No global state. No project-specific code, hardcoded paths, credentials, or environment-specific values. All dependencies must be declared in widget.json tech_stack.dependencies. Do not modify library_notes — it is managed by Cartographer and will be restored on checkin.

language_notes.python: Use pytest for all tests — no unittest. Type hints required on all public functions. No __init__.py in tests/. No if __name__ == '__main__' blocks in src/ files. Imports ordered: stdlib, third-party, local.
language_notes.javascript: Use vitest for all tests. ES modules only — no CommonJS require(). JSDoc type annotations on all exported functions. No global side effects at module load time.
language_notes.typescript: Use vitest for all tests. Strict mode enabled. No any types without explicit justification in a comment. Export types alongside implementations.
language_notes.go: Use the standard testing package. All exported functions must have godoc comments. No init() functions with side effects.
language_notes.rust: Use cargo test. Document all public items with ///. No unwrap() in library code — propagate errors with ?.
language_notes.cpp: Use CMake + Google Test. No raw owning pointers — use smart pointers. Header guards or #pragma once required.
language_notes.c: Use CMake + Unity test framework. No dynamic allocation without corresponding free. All functions documented with Doxygen comments.
